problem_statement: Configuring a per-channel max transmit power must support fine-grained 0.01 dBm (mBm) values and an explicit 'disable this channel' sentinel, instead of only coarse integer dBm. When a max-power table is configured at mBm granularity, each configured channel must be restored with its own target power on RCP recovery (read back through the power settings), unconfigured channels must keep the table default, and a disabled channel must be represented by the invalid mBm sentinel. The platform must accept and translate these mBm values, and disabling a channel via the sentinel must leave the legacy max-power path untouched. Without the new disabled-channel sentinel in the public radio API, code that disables a channel through the mBm interface cannot be built.
